question.text: 'Saraswati Growth Fund' has INR 500 crore commitments. Over 4 years, 85% of commitments have been called. What is the aggregate capital still unfunded?

explanation.text: The Logic: Unfunded commitment = 15% x INR 500 crore = INR 75 crore. This represents capital still committed by LPs but not yet drawn down. The Trap: INR 50 cr uses 10%. INR 85 cr confuses 85 with the percent. INR 100 cr uses 20%. Note: The workbook supports commitments, drawn-down capital, and dry powder/pending drawdowns. Follow-on reserve and strategy commentary has been removed as it is not directly supported.
